###LV
Laipni lūgti pēdējās vasaras sacensībās Latvijā! Izbaudi pēdējās vasaras dienas mierīgā un varbūt kaut nedaudz sācensīgā gaisotnē kopā ar draugiem un ģimeni! 
**Regulāri pārbaudiet savu epastu un šīs sacensību lapas papildus cilnes, lai nepalaistu garām svarīgus atjauninājumus!**
###ENG
Welcome to the last summer competition in Latvia! Spend the last days of summer in a relaxed and maybe just a little competitive setting with Your friends and family! 
**Check the additional tabs of this competition page and your email regularly to not miss any important updates!**

items.name: Waukesha Weeknights 2026
items.information:
This competition takes place on a **Wednesday evening**. Please make sure to check the schedule and arrange your travel accordingly.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
​
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcDAwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9d340df17a1aec4ba42677c10d4db2f31757ffba/image.png)
​
You can find out about upcoming competitions in [Wisconsin](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=Wisconsin) and [Illinois](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=Illinois) by clicking on the links respectively.
